mask_creation.dilation: one pixel in a 3x3 neighborhood around foreground text
mask_creation.purpose: Keep the white text and its adjacent edges; exclude the moving city background.

limitations: The text is shared by the two configured rubbish stations; no second-city source image was supplied.
No live-game calibration or testing was performed.
City identity and back-button evidence are also required before classifying the city panel.
